error.generic: Something went wrong while handling that command.
error.unknownCommand: That command is not available yet.
link.title: Link your account
link.help:
Link an account to your Discord profile. API token is one time use & used to verify that the account is yours.
Find your token in Settings → More Settings → API Token. [Open settings](https://link.clashofclans.com/?action=OpenMoreSettings) · [Illustrated guide](https://assets.clashk.ing/bot/images/api_token_help.png)
link.required: Enter both your player tag and API token.
link.already: {tag} is already linked to your Discord account.
link.success: Linked {tag} to your Discord account. Ownership verified.
link.invalidToken: That API token does not match this player. Copy it from Clash of Clans Settings → More Settings and try again.
link.notFound: No player was found with that tag. Check your player tag and try again.
link.conflict: The account could not be linked. Check the API token and try again.
link.unavailable: Account verification is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
link.helpTitle: Finding your player tag and API token
link.tagHelp: Open your player profile and copy the player tag. Do not use your clan tag.
unlink.success: {tag} has been unlinked from your Discord account.
unlink.notFound: That player is not linked to your Discord account.
unlink.conflict: This is your last verified account. Verify another linked account before unlinking it.
base.title: Share a base
base.help: Paste your Clash of Clans layout link, write a description, and upload 1–4 screenshots. Your base will be posted in this channel.
base.required: Enter a base link and a description of 1–1,000 characters.
base.imageInvalid: Each screenshot must be a PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP image no larger than 25 MiB.
base.invalidLegacyButton: This legacy base button is invalid.
base.missingChannel: Discord did not include a channel for this command.
base.missingMessage: Discord did not include the legacy base message.
base.missingMessageChannel: Discord did not include the base message channel.
base.unavailable: This legacy base is not available for conversion.
base.wrongMessage: This base button does not belong to this message.
base.invalidLegacyLink: This legacy base has an invalid Clash of Clans layout link and was not converted.
base.wrongLocation: This base is already bound to a different Discord message location.
base.missingImage: The original base image is no longer available, so this message cannot be converted.
base.copyFailed: The base image could not be copied into ClashKing storage. The message remains unconverted; please try again.
base.updateFailed: Discord could not update the base message. The base remains unconverted; please try again.
base.finalizeFailed: The base message was updated, but its conversion could not be finalized. Click one of its new buttons to retry.
base.uploadFailed: A screenshot could not be stored. No base was posted. Run /base again and re-upload your images.
base.postFailed: The base could not be confirmed as posted. Check this channel before trying again.
error.guild: This command must be used in a server.
error.user: Discord did not include an invoking user.
error.tag: That is not a valid Clash tag.
error.invalidInteraction: This control is not valid for this interaction. Run the command again.
